original: scape looks different, so\nI don't know how to find the\nVillage of Beginnings...
I'm tired! I can't take another\nstep...
Hang in there, tama! I'll be back\nwith some food, tama!
Ah! No, no, I didn't mean to...
But we'd like to do something\nuseful, tama! So wait for us,\ntama!
Aren't they being a little *too*\nnice to me?
Wow! You even found some cola! Aw,\nbut it's not cold...
Let me borrow it. I'll chill it up\nfor you.
Burn, burn, burn! And it's cooked.
You know, Jou... you don't have to\nbe a doctor if you don't want to.
That's what Dad wants. But you\nneed to find your own path for\nyourself.
Find my own path... Is that what\nyou did, Yamato?
This is the Village of Beginnings.
Was that... the sound of a\nharmonica?
What?! It was you... I was so sure\nit was...
Now that the Village of Beginnings\nis like this, there's nothing left\nfor me to do...
By the way, how are Takeru and\nPatamon doing?
Hey, why don't you come with us?
The village won't go back to\nnormal until we defeat the Dark\nMasters.
We're looking for allies to help\nus!
Defeat the Dark Masters? Man, you\nguys think big!
We're not just thinking about it!\nThe fight's already started!
Well, I guess I can't just let\nPatamon one-up me!
I'll come with you, then! You guys\nwon't be able to do anything by\nyourselves, anyway.
Oh, this? Someone dropped it on\nthe shore. I found it there.
Dropped? Let me see it for a\nsecond...\nYep, it's Yamato's.
Really? Then he must be around\nhere! But...
Now that you mention it, I saw a\nswan boat going off into the\nsea...
I thought it was the Nightmare\nSoldiers doing something weird\nagain.
No doubt about it, it's Yamato.\nListen, Mimi...
Now that we've gotten some more\nallies, Gomamon and I don't need\nto be here anymore, right?
Huh? What do you mean? Are you\ngoing somewhere, Jou?
But then we should all go\ntogether...
No, Gomamon and I will go by\nourselves.
We have to follow our own paths.
You're taking the path of finding\nallies, Mimi. Taichi's group is \ntaking the path of fighting.
No, no, I'm not going to let\nTaichi fight by himself. I want to\nfight, too!
And I thought, "But I'm not\nstrong, I'm only getting in the\nway..."
But I'm pretty sure there's\nsomething that only I can do!
I think that's the kind of thing\nYamato was thinking, too. So I'm\ngonna go after him!
Let 'im go. He's tougher than he\nlooks!
Is it okay for me to come to a\nconclusion, just like that?
Yamato, this cave creeps me out.\nLet's find a way out of here!
I've always been saying that\nTakeru needs me, but the truth is \nthat I'm the one who needed him.
If I got him to depend on me, then\nI'd have my life's purpose...
That's why I always got mad at\nTaichi. I felt like he was taking\nhim away from me...
It's over for me. I can't just go\nback to being their friend.
Don't say that! All eight of us\nhave to work together if we wanna\nsave the world!
They don't need me. Nothing would\nchange if I weren't there...
There's only one of you in this\nworld, Yamato!
What am *I* supposed to do if\nyou're not here?
I spent all this time in this\nworld, waiting for you!
Do you really want to be alone?\nBecause if you really, truly do,\nI'll leave.
No, I don't want to be alone... I\nlied.
I was just trying to feel cool...\nbut the truth is... I'm really\nlonely.
I always thought, "I shouldn't\ncry"... But I really, really want\nto!
I'm here, right? I'm relying on\nyou...
So you can rely on me, and we'll\nbe able to do more together!
Gabumon... you're right, you're\nhere with me.
I've got friends... I've got\nTakeru, and my mom and dad...
That thing was floating around\nyou. Didn't you notice?
It was trying to get inside your\nheart.
No, that's not it... the darkness\nin my lonely heart was attracting\nit.
It's only gonna get tougher from\nhere on out, so I'm going to have\nto rely on you quite a bit.
I'm not gonna just sit around and\ncomplain anymore.
I don't mind if you do, as long as\nI'm the only one you do it to!
Fine! Then I'll save my\ncomplaints, just for you!
See? Did you see that? Look who\nfound him!
I just wanted to tell you that you\nshould follow your own path, and\nhave faith in it...
So what do we do now?
We can't find Yamato at all...
(At this rate, Taichi and the\nothers are going to...)
(No, I have to find them... I\npromised I would... I'll find\nthem, no matter what...)
Sora! There's something black on\nyour feet!
Ah! Yamato! Where were you? I was\nso worried...
I'm really sorry. I won't leave\nyou from now on. I promise.
It's a cave like the one we were\nin before...
Sora! What's wrong? Come on, get\nup...
And Jou, and Yamato... if I can't\nhelp Taichi, our world's done\nfor...
She's being saying that for a\nwhile now.
I have to get myself together... I\nhave to help Taichi... Or else the\nworld will end...
Sora, you've got a real sense of\nresponsibility...
Sora, you have to stop thinking\nlike that! This cave comes from \nthe darkness inside your heart!
You don't have to do anything if\nyou don't want to! We came this\nfar because we did!
If I don't want to... No, I have\nto...
Sora, I know that things really\ndon't look good for us right\nnow...
But we've come this far because we\ncan get past it!
We've come this far... because we\ncan get past it!
We can do it! That's right!
I'm glad to see you back to\nnormal, Sora!
Let's go meet up with Taichi!
All right, it's time to go!
